title: Enterprise legal on‑ramp: security questionnaire triage + contract risk runbook
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Goal: establish a repeatable, low-friction 'legal on‑ramp' for incoming enterprise opportunities that combines fast security questionnaire triage, standardized contract negotiation guardrails (MSA/DPA/SLAs, liability caps, indemnity), and a decision matrix that links pricing/packaging tiers to negotiation tolerance. Deliverables: (1) a runbook for Sales and Solutions to triage security questionnaires within 48 business hours; (2) a mapping table that assigns standard concessions per packaging tier (self-serve, growth, enterprise); (3) a lightweight approval flow in the console for exceptions; (4) updated playbook docs for Legal and RevOps and a small pilot with two strategic accounts. Why: slow or inconsistent handling of SQs and contract asks is increasing deal cycle time for mid‑market and enterprise and creating untracked legal risk. Success metrics: median SQ triage time <= 2 business days, reduction in average negotiation cycles for Tier 2 deals from 23 to <=14 calendar days, and legal exceptions tracked with rationale in a single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Published runbook in Confluence with stepwise triage checklist and owner matrix; 2) Decision matrix (packaging -> allowed concessions) reviewed and signed off by Legal and Sales leadership; 3) Pilot closed looped with two deals and documented learnings; 4) RevOps implements a labeled field in CRM to flag exceptions; 5) <48h SQ triage observed in pilot sample of 8 leads.
tradeoffs: Speed vs. Legal Rigor: aggressive SLA for triage risks superficial responses—we'll mitigate with a defined 'escalate' path for any 'unknown' items. Packaging-driven concessioning reduces negotiation touchpoints but may lose flexibility for strategic customers. Automating approvals reduces latency but increases need for clear guardrails and audit logs.
out_of_scope: Full automation of contract generation, creation of new legal language for bespoke indemnities, platform changes beyond CRM labeling and a small console flag for exception routing.
